rows.expected_carrier: Recommended once fixed: Carrier B Road standard £660.00, ETA 29-10-2026
rows.actual_carrier: Recommended once fixed: Carrier B Road standard £660.00, ETA 29-10-2026
issues: R-01 [MUG-01]: MUG-01 (Ceramic coffee mug, 350 ml) has HS code 90111, which is only 5 digits (minimum 6).

R-02: Declared value is £5,000.00 but the items add up to £5,450.00 (MUG-01: 1080 × £5.00 = £5,400.00; PB-01: 10 × £5.00 = £50.00). The declared value is £450.00 (8.257%) lower; the limit is 1% (£54.50).
R-03 [MUG-01]: MUG-01 (Ceramic coffee mug, 350 ml): 12 units per carton × 85 cartons = 1020 units, but quantity is 1080 (60 units more than fit). The receiving warehouse will count a mismatch.
R-04: Booking says 84 cartons, but the items add up to 86 (MUG-01: 85 + PB-01: 1). Difference: 2 cartons.
R-05: 1600 kg ÷ 3 pallets = 533.33 kg per pallet, over Carrier A Road economy's limit of 500 kg (by 33.33 kg). The carrier would refuse the pallets at collection.
R-06 [PB-01]: PB-01 (Lithium-ion power bank 10000 mAh) looks like lithium batteries (matched: lithium, power bank, HS 850760). These can't go on this service.
R-08: This shipment goes to a warehouse in Frankfurt, but no delivery appointment is booked. Warehouses usually turn away trucks without a slot, which causes re-delivery fees and delays.
R-09 [MUG-01]: MUG-01 (Ceramic coffee mug, 350 ml) has no country of origin. Customs needs to know where the product was made (not where it ships from) to set the duty.
R-10: Ready to ship date is 01-10-2026, 25 days before today (26-10-2026). A carrier can't collect in the past, and delivery estimates will be wrong.
rows.confirmation: Once the issues above are fixed, your 3 pallets (86 cartons of 2 different products, £5,000.00) will be collected from Manchester on Monday 26-10-2026 by Carrier B Road standard and should arrive at the Frankfurt warehouse on Thursday 29-10-2026 (estimated delivery).
